flags.message: The frozen context records distribution_count=1, but the snapshot's only distribution (May 19, for the June 4 conference) predates the paid petition's August 6 docketing and appears to concern linked miscellaneous matter 25M81 and the veteran-status motion denied June 8. The petition itself was not yet due a response until September 8. I preserved the harness-frozen count when forecasting relist-increment, so that claim is high because the petition's expected first real distribution will mechanically increase the count; it should not be interpreted as a forecast of a true relist.
